reason: Hypothesis A proposes a specific, testable mechanism—reducing reactive elements and refining grain structure to promote selective oxidation of Cr and Al into a protective CrTaO4-based layer—directly addressing the limitation of non-protective oxide formation in HEAs, with a clear intervention, baseline, and falsification experiment. Hypothesis B, while plausible, focuses narrowly on Al/Cr ratio without addressing the known detrimental role of reactive elements like Ti/Mn, and its mechanism is less novel given prior work on Al2O3/Cr2O3 layers in ultrafine-grained HEAs.
